kamloops.title: 2 men charged in connection with fatal shooting of man in Langley taxi
kamloops.description: On Aug. 14, 2026, IGHT investigators arrested 35-year-old Jared Douglas Polischuk and 29-year-old Luis Manuel Baez in relation to the homicide.

kamloops.title: What you need to know about B.C. wildfires on Aug. 16
kamloops.description: The B.C. Wildfire Service (BCWS) says it's keeping an eye on an unstable weather pattern that could produce more wildfires in the southern half of the province on Sunday, even as evacuation orders are slowly lifted near some of the province's most concerning fires.

kamloops.title: Homes across B.C. have been decimated by wildfires. Here's what to know about your insurance
kamloops.description: Hundreds of structures have been lost to wildfires so far this year.  Experts say even those who are fully insured will face a long, complex process as they begin to rebuild.

all.title: More B.C. evacuees returning home Saturday, but told to prepare for changes
all.description: Residents are advised to take precautions when they return home, including sanitizing their fridges as they clear out spoiled food, and to assess trees and property for damages.

all.title: Vancouver Island park closed following black bear attack
all.description: B.C. Conservation Officers said that shortly before 10 a.m. Friday morning, a woman was hiking with her dogs off-leash in Stoney Hill Regional Park, east of Duncan.

all.title: All evacuation orders downgraded for Quilpituk Creek wildfire, residents return home
all.description: All residents who were forced out of their homes due to the Quilpituk Creek wildfire, burning north of West Kelowna, were allowed to go home on Friday.

all.title: Conservative candidate says he’s heard Poilievre criticism from voters
all.description: The comments came during an all-candidates panel for the Aug. 31 byelection in North Vancouver—Capilano, where the Conservatives are hoping to flip a seat from the Liberals.

all.title: Canadair water-bomber builder feels heat of demand as wildfires rage around the world
all.description: As Canada, the United States and Europe grapple with another brutal wildfire season, pressure is building on the manufacturer of the Canadair "Super Scooper" water bombers to increase production, and on the federal government to bulk order the planes.

all.title: Thousands of residents in B.C.'s Interior can return home as some evacuation orders downgraded to alerts
all.description: B.C. residents in some wildfire areas will be able to return to their homes Friday, as some evacuation orders are downgraded to alerts.
